The club went defunct after having lots of financial problems and not being able to climb up the Kosovo football league system, but were refounded the following year after a merger with another club, thus adopting a new name, new colors for the club and a new crest.{{Cite news|url=https://topsporti.com/artikulli/sc-besa-nis-prej-liges-se-pare/ffk-1|title=SC Besa nis prej Ligës së Parë|date=25 May 2024|access-date=15 June 2024}}"}}
